name: m6-menu-frame
description: Differential policy for the reconstructed Metal execution of a captured original-OpenGL frame. The only declared normalization is row origin; every other difference is a test result, not a tolerance.

alpha.reason: The GL drawable carries a meaningful alpha channel for this frame; alpha is compared, not masked.

notes: Thresholds start exact because the Metal replay consumes the exact captured inputs.
A non-zero threshold is admissible only with measured evidence of legitimate backend variation, recorded in the qualification report.
